_meta.purpose: Design contract — the token vocabulary. Use the `class` in .dc.html and in TSX; never raw hex.
_meta.authority: Claude Design is SSOT for design values. This file is authored by CD, not extracted from globals.css. globals.css must be reconciled TO this file.
_meta.rule: Existing token → use its `class`. Intentional new value → label `proposed-token:<name>` and raise it to CD for promotion into this file. Never hardcode.
changed_in_2_0: pastel.aqua #bfe9ef ADDED (Desk Research identity; replaces the ad-hoc name 'cyan')
shadow.memphis-* shadow colour #000 → var(--color-ink) #1d1b20 (was already true of memphis-2xl; now consistent)
signal.error family ADDED (the 4-state deliverable status vocabulary requires it)
surface.canvas #fbfbf9 ADDED (neutral canvas; the yellow surface-accent is canvas-shell only)
radius scale EXTENDED (nav 8, icon 9, control 10, card 11, panel 12, panel-lg 16, field 22)
type_scale print family ADDED (print-body 16, print-h2 19, print-h1 30)
font.mono ADDED as a scoped technical-label token (was blanket-forbidden)

amore.role: PRIMARY brand/action accent — CTA, active, selection, focus, live edge

amore-deep.role: ADDED 2.0 — destructive/emphasis crimson: End-session, Σ totals, active crosstab cell, link colour

amore-bg.role: accent background tint — participant avatars, selected-row tint base

accent._purple_note: raw-accent-purple #a06fda is NOT a @theme utility. Use accent-violet for UI.

ink.role: primary text · all Memphis borders · all Memphis shadows

mute-soft.role: caption / very mute — AA borderline, never body copy on white

faint.role: ADDED 2.0 — mono captions, placeholders, settled caption lines

paper-soft.role: elevated / input bg / table head / footer

canvas.role: ADDED 2.0 — neutral page/frame background. Use for fullview frames, library, share pages, documents.

disabled.role: ADDED 2.0 — disabled control track. NEVER dim a wrapper with opacity to express disabled.

_surface-banner.role: canvas widget-header default (yellow) — canvas shell only, not a general surface

_surface-accent.role: canvas sidebar bg (yellow) — canvas shell only. Do NOT use for documents or library surfaces.

line-empty.role: ADDED 2.0 — dashed empty-state border, unfilled indicator dots

_border-ink.role: heavy Memphis outline = ink (NOT #000). button 2px · card 2.5–3px · canvas card 3px

signal._note: 4-state deliverable status vocabulary is shared by every feature: draft · processing · ready · error. Status is expressed by dot + tinted pill + text label — never by colour alone.

success-text.role: ADDED 2.0 — text on success tint. Do NOT snap to #16a34a (contrast regression).

processing.role: ADDED 2.0 — processing dot · progress accent (alias of accent-violet)

amber.role: ADDED 2.0 — spotlight border, confidence-medium, partial-fill dots. Distinct from warning #fb923c: amber is a state, warning is an alert.

amber-text-deep.role: ADDED 2.0 — spotlight meta / emphasis on warning-bg

violet.role: ADDED 2.0 — Transcript progress, theme counts, RQ marker

lav-line.role: ADDED 2.0 — border on lav tint (processing pill)

lav-bg.role: ADDED 2.0 — lav surface tint (AI summary, processing rows)

pastel._note: Feature identity. One tone per feature, never invented per surface. CHANGED in 2.0: peach and sun now match the shipped comps; aqua added.

aqua.role: Desk Research — glyph ◈. ADDED 2.0 (supersedes the ad-hoc name 'cyan').

pastel_tint._note: ADDED 2.0 — the pale wash paired with each pastel, for section-head tints and row tints inside a document or report. Never used as a widget header.

radius._note: EXTENDED in 2.0. The 1.x scale (2/4/14/24/999) could not express the shipped components; every gap below was already in production comps as an arbitrary value.

chip.role: ADDED 2.0 — mono micro-badge, table cell highlight

nav.role: ADDED 2.0 — sidebar nav item, filter row, small select

control.role: ADDED 2.0 — input, link field, footnote card

card.role: ADDED 2.0 — inner card (persona, RQ, list row)

field.role: ADDED 2.0 — search / inject / add-row field and its paired button

border_width._note: applied via border-[Npx]. Colour is ALWAYS ink — never #000.

shadow._note: Memphis hard offset, blur ALWAYS 0. CHANGED in 2.0: the shadow colour is ink #1d1b20 for the whole family (memphis-2xl already was). Never shadow-[..].

memphis-sm-faint.role: ADDED 2.0 — panel/list card, softer than solid sm

frame.role: ADDED 2.0 — full-surface frame (fullview, library, share page)

tile-lift.role: ADDED 2.0 — the ONE soft shadow: participant video tile, in-monitor mock UI

focus-ring.role: ADDED 2.0 — :focus-visible on every interactive element. Non-negotiable: keyboard users otherwise have no affordance.

type_scale._note: screen family unchanged. print family ADDED in 2.0 — exported documents are read at paper distance and must clear a 12pt floor.

print-h1.role: ADDED 2.0 — document title (34px for a report cover)

sans.value: Pretendard Variable, Pretendard, Inter, Apple SD Gothic Neo, system-ui

outfit.role: display/heading — titles, section heads, large numerals. Promoted in 2.0 from a scoped var to a named token.

mono.role: ADDED 2.0 — RESTRICTED: technical labels only (timestamps, IDs, counts, tiers, table heads, eyebrow captions, page numbers). Never body copy, never a heading. This replaces the 1.x blanket ban, which the shipped comps had already outgrown.

font._logo_only: Poppins Bold — logo wordmark SVG only, never in UI.

motion._reduced: ADDED 2.0 — every animation must be neutralised under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

geometry._note: ADDED 2.0 — shared shell measurements. Frames are container-owned (the app supplies width/height); these are the design proto sizes and the fixed internal parts.

widget-card.role: collapsed canvas widget card · border 3px · radius 20 · shadow memphis-lg

sticky-table.role: check / name / contact sticky columns — border-separate, right shadow on the last sticky cell

page-letter.role: exported document page · margins 84 × 72 · holds on A4

calendar-hour.role: one hour of calendar height; a 30-min block is 40px with a 40px floor

widget_accent._note: per-feature identity. Set once, reused on every surface that feature appears on: canvas card header, fullview header, sidebar dot, library row tile, share masthead, document tone bar.

iconography.system: duotone inline SVG on a 24 grid, 2px stroke, tone-matched to the owning feature
iconography.emoji: permitted in copy and as content markers; NOT permitted as a UI control glyph
